items.title: Two corner windows swap in either order
items.text: With a film in the corner and a camera floated after it, Left and Right now swap between the two and the focus stays on the window, the same as when the camera came first.

items.title: Focus stays on the swap
items.text: Swapping from the camera to the film no longer drops the focus, so you can keep swapping without double-clicking OK again.
